page.layout: One page of text in a single block, with a running head at the top and the page number at the top right. The first lines run across the full width, then the text continues in a justified block. A margin number "10" stands in the left margin. The lower half is blurred and largely unreadable. Large display letters in the middle are show-through from the reverse side and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: Scotorum regionibus deliluerunt: Magistratus, & munerum publicorum procurationes omnibus, quos vel paulum attigerat suspicio, adempti, & eorum inimicis traditi. Per praeconem edictum (nec, in tanta moestitia publica, sine risu) ne quis diceret, Regem aut participem, aut conscium Davidicae caedis fuisse. Hac rerum perturbatione, post Id. Aprilis, paulum sedata, Comites Argathelix, & Moraviae in gratiam recepti: ipsi non multo post, appropinquante puerperii tempore, in arcem Edimburgensem secessit: atque, decimonono die Iunii, paulo post horam horam aequinoctialem, filium peperit, cui, postea Iacobo Sexto nomen fuit.10

page.notes: The upper third of the page is legible; the lower two-thirds are too blurred to read, so those lines are marked illegible. The large display letters in the centre (apparently "SCOTIAE HISTORIAE") appear mirrored and look like show-through from the other side of the leaf, so they are not transcribed as a heading. The margin figure "10" beside the paragraph is taken as a marginal line number. Some words in the first paragraph are uncertain, and I have not marked them with [?] because the reading is clear enough, though "Argathelix" and "Moraviae" should be checked against the scan.
